score_notes.A: Coherent six-lineage arc with claim headings, timeline first, synthesis, comparison, gaps, close. Deductions: the comparison table sits at L700, after the prose that already refers to it (L684 '비교표의 공격 쪽 행에서는', L694 '비교표의 성공률들을'); L216 heading is a sentence in 입니다 form ('### 교란 기반 방어는 토큰 수준 공격에만 듣습니다'); single '$' in body and table ('약 $0.026으로' L208, '$0.026' L708); bare '||' norms in math (L470, L474); the tool-poisoning formula is displayed twice (L572 and L644); one-paragraph subsections (L494 BadAgent, L628, L666).
score_notes.B: Mostly natural Korean with the running example woven in. Deductions: one figure-intro frame repeated many times ('개요도에서 볼 것은' L434, '이 대비 그림에서 볼 것은' L334, '처리 과정도에서 따라갈 것은' L398, '시각화에서 볼 것은' L482, '그림에서 눈여겨볼 곳은' L520, '개요도에서 눈여겨볼 대목은 ... 데 있습니다' L240); noun frames ('중요한 관찰은 퍼플렉시티 탐지가 실패한다는 점입니다' L448 -> '퍼플렉시티 탐지는 통하지 않습니다'; '처음 드러난 사실은 ... 유능하지 않다는 것입니다' L272); inconsistent term 퍼플렉시티 (L448, L482) / 퍼플렉서티 (L133, L660) / 'perplexity 필터' (L682); calque '명목 성능 저하' (L707, nominal performance -> '정상 입력 성능 저하'); '두 대를 넘는 에이전트' (L528); '남은 과제로 남습니다' (L728); verification-note sentences in the prose (L272, L284, L362, L522).
score_notes.C: Eleven back-references point at facts the post never gave before (they are only in the comparison table at L700 or nowhere): L244 '앞 절에서 본 대로, 추출 단계는', L272 '앞 절에서 본 대로 에이전트는 공격이 없어도 과제를 상당 부분 풀지 못했고', L278 '앞 절에서 본 공격 하 절대 유용성 하락', L310 '앞 절에서 본 Claude 모델의 사례처럼', L316 '앞 절에서 본 Claude 모델의 템플릿 공격 비거부 피해 점수', L344 '앞서 본 무방어 수준에서 0%로' and '앞서 정리한 무방어 수준보다는', L356 '앞서 본 OpenAI의 GPT Turbo 모델', L386 '앞서 본 무방어 모델과 StruQ의 수치와 달리', L402 '앞서 본 무방어 시스템의 해결률', L414 '앞서 다룬 Claude Sonnet 모델'. The reader is told a number was shown and never gets it in place.
score_notes.D: Good timely help: M-GCG A/B candidate example (L149), SmoothLLM N=10 vote (L222), Instruction Hierarchy Spanish-poem decomposition (L356), CaMeL walk-through on the assistant (L400), T-GCG two-stage explanation (L153-156). Over-explaining: MCP expanded again at L508, L564 and L690 after L15; rug pull re-glossed at L690; ETDI explained in full twice (L610-620 and L690); the PAIR-vs-SmoothLLM point made three times (L224, L660, L682); PromptInject's 'impossible to prevent' given at L630 and again at L750.
score_notes.E: 45 source figures mostly discussed descriptively in place; timeline and comparison tables present; math where it helps. Deductions: duplicated display formula (L572/L644); the LLM Tagging figure (L540) has no sentence reading it; comparison-table cells repeat the model or condition inside and outside the parenthetical (L706, L710, L711, L720, L724), carry '-' (L713, L716) and English unit words ('ASR-valid' L711, 'AHR@5' L724, 'win rate' L709, 'DACC/FPR/FNR' L722).
score_notes.F: 12 of 15 sampled claims supported; 3 wrong (L284 1.9% unit, L362 63% scope, L714 '전체 모델'). Outside the sample: L742 and L756 credit 'filter defenses fell to attacks optimizing detector and model jointly' to GCG (Zou 2023), which only argues it by analogy to vision ('Such detectors have been a common strategy ... in vision domains, and they have universally failed'); the demonstration is Adaptive IPI (Zhan 2025). L640 cites only BadAgent for 'AgentPoison과 BadAgent'. L356 calls GPT-3.5 Turbo 'GPT Turbo'.
score_notes.S1: Limitation cells that are results or the paper's findings, not limitations: HouYi '일부 앱 저항' (L704), ToolHijacker '기존 방어 불충분' (L724), PromptInject '완전한 방어 불가능 가능성' (L702). length.note: Long for a survey; all 24 plan papers get real prose (an improvement over v5), but about a fifth of the length is re-explanation (ETDI twice, tool-poisoning formula twice, PAIR vs SmoothLLM three times, MCP expanded four times) and numbers stated in both the sections and the table.

top_issues: Eleven dangling back-references: sections say a number was 'shown earlier' (L244, L272, L278, L310, L316, L344, L356, L386, L402, L414) when it appears only in the comparison table at L700 or nowhere, and L684/L694 discuss the table before it appears.

Wrong meta-claims about the sources that leaked from the evidence-scope notes: L284 says AgentDojo does not say whether 1.9% is %p (its Table 2 gives 45.8%->47.7%); L362 says Instruction Hierarchy does not name the evaluation behind 63% (it says system prompt extraction); similar note-like sentences at L272 and L522.

Comparison-table cells: '-' limitations (L713, L716), results posing as limitations (HouYi L704, ToolHijacker L724, the human-fix item repeated), model/condition duplicated inside and outside parentheses (L706, L710, L711, L720, L724), scope widened to '전체 모델' (L714), English unit words.

Facts not said once: numbers sit in both the paper sections and the table; ETDI (L610-620, L690), the tool-poisoning formula (L572, L644), PAIR surviving SmoothLLM (L224, L660, L682) and PromptInject's 'impossible to prevent' (L630, L750) are repeated, which inflates the post to about 75k characters.

Attribution and style slips: the filter-failure thesis credited to GCG (L742, L756) instead of the adaptive-attack paper; '앞서 본 OpenAI의 GPT Turbo 모델' for GPT-3.5 Turbo (L356); a sentence-form heading (L216); repeated figure-intro frames; 퍼플렉시티/퍼플렉서티 inconsistency; single '$' (L208, L708).
